text:
mika: quick sync — we ship the devex bundle tomorrow. finalizing SDK + docs + quickstarts. who owns changelog cutoff and sampleapp QA? pinging @jonas @priya @sam for owners and blockers

jonas: SDK freeze is still on schedule. i'm owning SDK merges. all API-breaking PRs are flagged. final PRs must land by EOD or we gate to next patch. current blocker: one flaky e2e failing on auth timeout :grimacing:

priya: docs freeze at 2pm PT. i'm taking changelog ownership — please drop entries in #docs-changelog using the template. i'll compile and cut the draft. any API note must be in by noon.

sam: sample apps mostly green. quickstart-js and quickstart-python are ok. quickstart-go is failing with a build error, @alexa is looking. otherwise I can prep release artifacts once joinauth is resolved. :thumbsup:

alexa: quickstart-go issue looks like a go.mod dependency mismatch (grpc v1.54 vs expected v1.52). trying a patch bump + replace directive. will open PR in ~45m.

mika: thanks. can we write a tiny fallback plan? if SDK merge slips, docs should ship without changed SDK snippets (pin examples to v1.2) and we do a follow-up patch release. who owns that cutover?

jonas: i can handle SDK rollback plan. strategy: if merge doesn't land by cutoff, revert SDK PRs and tag new changelog entry noting delayed SDK features. also we can ship docs with pinned client references.

release-bot: created release checklist -> https://git.internal/release/4573 (PR: https://git.internal/r/devex/release-4573). checklist snippet:

```
- [ ] SDK merge ✅/rollback
- [ ] Changelog compiled by @priya
- [ ] Quickstarts smoke tests green
- [ ] Sample apps PRs merged
- [ ] Release notes drafted
- [ ] Canary deploy + perf smoke
```

qa-bot: running smoke tests on staging now. current status 12/15 passing. failing tests: auth-token-refresh, go quickstart build. logs: https://ci.internal/builds/8891

jonas: auth timeout is a known flaky in CI — increasing test timeout in harness (PR https://git.internal/r/devex/ci/patch-112). that should stabilize the e2e.

priya: changelog entries so far (drop me more):
- docs: quickstart CLI flags clarified
- sdk: client now strips duplicate headers (breaking for some proxies)
- sampleapps: removed deprecated embed example
I'll add the rc note about the header behavior change.

sam: sample app fix PR: https://git.internal/r/devex/sampleapps/pull/234 needs review from @jonas and @alexa. quickstart-go patch included.

mika: summary owners: SDK = jonas, docs/changelog = priya, sampleapps = sam + alexa, QA = qa-bot. cutoff in ~4h. if you see a hard blocker ping me directly. please add into PR descriptions the release tag `release/4573` so we can grep. :eyes:

alexa: noted — will add tag. quickstart-go PR up in 30m.

jonas: i'll watch CI and be ready to revert if needed. ping me on DM for urgent merges.

priya: compiling changelog draft now, will post in 1h for review.

qa-bot: staging retest queued after harness timeout bump. expected finish ~30m. will post final status here.

mika: perfect. thanks everyone — keep updates brief here. i'll run cutover checklist at cutoff. :shipit:
